mesh_threshold_semantics: VDBFusion MarchingCubes.cpp: a cube is dropped if ANY of its 8 corners has weight < min_weight (strict <), so kept corners have weight >= min_weight (>=1 for M, >=5 for R); weights are integer counts (constant +1 per observation)
mesh_timer_coverage: perf_counter around vdbfusion extract_triangle_mesh(fill_holes=True, min_weight) (C++ marching cubes over all active voxels + pybind conversion to numpy); PLY write excluded. cold = first call for this row (after the other row's calls for row R), warm = 2 further calls.
mesh_incremental_ms: n/a (VDBFusion has no incremental / dirty-block meshing)
peak_host_rss_method: timev.py getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss (GNU /usr/bin/time not installed); whole process incl. mesh extraction + .vdb write + numpy buffers
device_memory: n/a (CPU-only library). Unified-memory proxy: system MemTotal-MemAvailable sampled every 50 ms by scripts/mem_sampler.py, peak minus the mean of the pre-run baseline samples = mem_sampler.sys_used_delta_peak_kb
active_voxel_count_method: OpenVDB file_voxel_count metadata of the TSDF grid in grids.vdb (written by extract_vdb_grids after integration), parsed by scripts/vdb_meta.py
block_count: n/a (OpenVDB 8^3 leaf-node count is not exposed by the vdbfusion pybind module without pyopenvdb; not estimated)
cpu_over_wall_note: (user+sys)/wall of the whole process from timev.json; ~1.0 or below = single-threaded
